<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class RBACService
{
    private array $roleHierarchy = [
        'admin' => ['manager', 'editor', 'viewer'],
        'manager' => ['editor', 'viewer'],
        'editor' => ['viewer'],
        'viewer' => [],
    ];

    private array $permissionMap = [
        'admin' => ['users.create', 'users.delete', 'users.modify', 'content.publish', 'content.edit', 'content.view', 'system.configure'],
        'manager' => ['users.modify', 'content.publish', 'content.edit', 'content.view'],
        'editor' => ['content.edit', 'content.view'],
        'viewer' => ['content.view'],
    ];

    private PDO $db;
    private string $hmacKey;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $hmacKey)
    {
        if (strlen($hmacKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('HMAC key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
    }

    /**
     * Validates session token integrity using HMAC-SHA256.
     * Returns the authenticated user context or null.
     */
    public function authenticateSession(string $sessionToken): ?array
    {
        if (strlen($sessionToken) > 512) {
            return null;
        }

        $parts = explode('.', $sessionToken);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }

        [$encodedHeader, $encodedPayload, $encodedSignature] = $parts;

        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $encodedHeader . '.' . $encodedPayload, $this->hmacKey);
        $providedSig = bin2hex(base64_decode($encodedSignature, true) ?: '');

        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return null;
        }

        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($encodedPayload, true) ?: '', true, 8, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        if (!is_array($payload) || !isset($payload['sub'], $payload['roles'], $payload['exp'])) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!is_int($payload['exp']) || $payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!is_string($payload['sub']) || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9\-]{36}$/', $payload['sub'])) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!is_array($payload['roles'])) {
            return null;
        }

        // Validate each role against known roles
        $validatedRoles = $this->validateRoles($payload['roles']);

        return [
            'userId' => $payload['sub'],
            'roles' => $validatedRoles,
            'exp' => $payload['exp'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validates roles from the token against the known role set.
     * Filters out any roles not in our hierarchy to prevent injection
     * of arbitrary role strings.
     */
    private function validateRoles(array $roles): array
    {
        $knownRoles = array_keys($this->roleHierarchy);
        $validated = [];

        foreach ($roles as $role) {
            // Check if the provided role exists in our known roles list
            if (in_array($role, $knownRoles)) {
                $validated[] = $role;
            }
        }

        return $validated;
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the user context has a specific permission.
     * Resolves role hierarchy to determine effective permissions.
     */
    public function hasPermission(array $userContext, string $permission): bool
    {
        if (!isset($userContext['roles']) || !is_array($userContext['roles'])) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z]+\.[a-z]+$/', $permission)) {
            return false;
        }

        $effectiveRoles = $this->resolveEffectiveRoles($userContext['roles']);
        $effectivePermissions = $this->resolvePermissions($effectiveRoles);

        return in_array($permission, $effectivePermissions, true);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the full set of roles including inherited ones.
     */
    private function resolveEffectiveRoles(array $assignedRoles): array
    {
        $effective = [];

        foreach ($assignedRoles as $role) {
            if (!is_string($role) || !isset($this->roleHierarchy[$role])) {
                continue;
            }
            $effective[] = $role;
            foreach ($this->roleHierarchy[$role] as $inherited) {
                if (!in_array($inherited, $effective, true)) {
                    $effective[] = $inherited;
                }
            }
        }

        return array_unique($effective);
    }

    /**
     * Maps roles to their permissions.
     */
    private function resolvePermissions(array $roles): array
    {
        $permissions = [];

        foreach ($roles as $role) {
            if (isset($this->permissionMap[$role])) {
                $permissions = array_merge($permissions, $this->permissionMap[$role]);
            }
        }

        return array_unique($permissions);
    }

    /**
     * Checks if user can perform an administrative action.
     * Requires the 'admin' role explicitly (not inherited).
     */
    public function isAdmin(array $userContext): bool
    {
        if (!isset($userContext['roles']) || !is_array($userContext['roles'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return in_array('admin', $userContext['roles']);
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves user data from database with parameterized query.
     */
    public function getUserData(array $userContext): ?array
    {
        if (!$this->hasPermission($userContext, 'users.modify')) {
            return null;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT id, username, email, role FROM users WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute(['id' => $userContext['userId']]);

        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    /**
     * Deletes a user account. Requires admin privileges.
     */
    public function deleteUser(array $userContext, string $targetUserId): bool
    {
        if (!$this->isAdmin($userContext)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9\-]{36}$/', $targetUserId)) {
            return false;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = :id');
        return $stmt->execute(['id' => $targetUserId]);
    }
}
